newsitem.title: GERMANY: ProSieben first bourse trade at 87 dmk.
newsitem.headline: ProSieben first bourse trade at 87 dmk.

text.p: Shares in German television network ProSieben AG were first traded on Frankfurt's bourse at a price of 87 markets on Monday.

The stock was earlier quoted at a bid price of 77 marks and ask price 87 marks. The bid/ask levels were below what some analysts had expected, but were in line with the offer price of 72 marks set on Saturday.
The share had been trading at prices of up to 120 marks in the grey market.
ProSieben's offering, which will raise 1.26 billion marks for the company and increase its capital by 360 million marks to over 700 million marks, was 50 times oversubscribed.
It is the first German television broadcaster to list its shares on the stock market.
